description: History-aware incident triage: bounded logs, redact, cluster, family merge (≤5 top families), ledger, change correlation, numbered repair options. No auto-repair. Excludes diagnostic corpus from ingest.
userTrigger: Launch swarm protocol → Runtime error doctor

lanes.A: Evidence + clustering + family merge (normalize, fingerprint, count, children)
lanes.B: Root-cause hypotheses + procedure map + competing explanations
lanes.C: Blast radius, probes, repair options, owner, rollback needs

chair: Nova synthesizes; Flash does not self-certify diagnosis
hardBans: no resolved without current passing probe

swarmPattern.note: v0.1 runs lanes in-process via CLI for determinism; optional Flash workers may re-validate report sections read-only

workers.task: Read doctor JSON clusters only; verify counts and sample redaction; no file bodies beyond report
Critique root-cause hypotheses; add competing explanations; do not edit ledger
Critique repair levels/owners; reject any auto-repair language
